description: Defines the QuicConfig class and related enums and classes for configuring QUIC protocol parameters, including transport parameters, connection options, and handshake message handling.

classes.name: QuicConfig
classes.description: Holds non-crypto configuration options negotiated during the crypto handshake, such as stream limits, timeouts, connection IDs, and transport parameters.

classes.name: QuicConfigValue
classes.description: Abstract base class for values that can be sent in handshake messages, with methods for serialization and processing peer hello messages.

classes.name: QuicFixedUint32
classes.description: Stores uint32_t values from handshake messages, with send/receive flags and processing methods.

classes.name: QuicFixedUint62
classes.description: Stores 62-bit numbers from handshake messages, serialized as 32-bit unsigned integers.

classes.name: QuicFixedStatelessResetToken
classes.description: Stores StatelessResetToken values, with send/receive flags and processing methods.

classes.name: QuicFixedTagVector
classes.description: Stores vectors of QuicTags, with methods for serialization and processing peer hello messages.

classes.name: QuicFixedSocketAddress
classes.description: Stores socket addresses, with send/receive flags and processing methods.

methods.name: QuicConfig
methods.description: Constructor, copy constructor, destructor, and configuration methods for setting and retrieving transport parameters, connection options, timeouts, and IDs.

methods.name: HasReceivedConnectionOptions
methods.description: Checks if connection options have been received.

methods.name: SetGoogleHandshakeMessageToSend
methods.description: Sets the handshake message to send.

methods.name: ProcessPeerHello
methods.description: Processes peer hello message for negotiation.
